The runner expects cwd at the repository root and the frozen pre-optimization CPU build at build/benchmark-final/build.json. The embedded historical runner incorrectly describes an output copy among excluded wrapper costs; paper Menon writes directly to caller output, as reflected in the corrected top-level scope.

harness_sources.build/paper-cpu-optimization/isa/run.py:
import ctypes as C,hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

root=Path.cwd()
dest=root/'build/paper-cpu-optimization/isa'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('run',root/'benchmark/run.py')
run=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(run)
case=next(c for c in json.load(open(root/'benchmark/datasets.json'))['images'] if c['dataset']=='div2k' and Path(c['path']).name=='0801.png')
rgb=run.load_image(case)[:1080,:1920].copy()
raws={p:run.mosaic(rgb,p) for p in run.PATTERNS}
old=run.Backend(json.load(open(root/'build/benchmark-final/build.json'))['cpu'],1)
expected={p:old.process(raws[p],'menon2007',p)[...,::-1] for p in run.PATTERNS}
old.close()
lib=C.CDLL(str(dest/'isa.so'))
lib.isa_create.argtypes=[C.c_int];lib.isa_create.restype=C.c_void_p
lib.isa_destroy.argtypes=[C.c_void_p];lib.isa_destroy.restype=None
lib.isa_process.argtypes=[C.c_void_p]*3+[C.c_int]*4;lib.isa_process.restype=None
contexts=[lib.isa_create(i) for i in range(3)]
assert all(contexts)
lanes=[(i,p) for i in range(3) for p in run.PATTERNS]
outputs=[np.empty_like(rgb) for lane in lanes];samples=[[] for lane in lanes]
def call(i):
    variant,phase=lanes[i]
    lib.isa_process(contexts[variant],raws[phase].ctypes.data,outputs[i].ctypes.data,1920,1080,1 if phase=='RGGB' else 2,variant)
for i,(variant,phase) in enumerate(lanes):
    call(i);np.testing.assert_array_equal(outputs[i],expected[phase])
for repeat in range(10):
    for i in range(len(lanes)):call(i)
rng=np.random.default_rng(20261009)
for repeat in range(100):
    for i in rng.permutation(len(lanes)):
        start=time.perf_counter_ns();call(i)
        samples[i].append((time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6)
rows=[]
for i,(variant,phase) in enumerate(lanes):
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(outputs[i],expected[phase])
    rows.append({'variant':['generic_fallback','avx2','avx512'][variant],'pattern':phase,'median_ms':float(np.median(samples[i])),
        'p10_ms':float(np.percentile(samples[i],10)),'p90_ms':float(np.percentile(samples[i],90)),
        'milliseconds_per_call':samples[i],'output_sha256_bgr':hashlib.sha256(outputs[i].tobytes()).hexdigest()})
for context in contexts:lib.isa_destroy(context)
result={'rows':rows,'affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'reference':case,'crop_yxhw':[0,0,1080,1920],
    'warmup_rounds':10,'rounds':100,'calls_per_sample':1,'seed':20261009,
    'scope':'One-thread direct rows function, retained workspace, per-tile halo and padding included; public wrapper padding, dispatch, and output copy excluded. Generic fallback can use baseline autovectorization. Python/ctypes overhead included.',
    'exact_to_frozen_old_public_output':True,
    'source_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):run.sha(p) for p in [root/'cpu/menon2007_cpu.hpp',dest/'bridge.cpp',dest/'run.py']},
    'library_sha256':run.sha(dest/'isa.so'),
    'command':['g++','-std=c++17','-O3','-shared','-fPIC','-I.','build/paper-cpu-optimization/isa/bridge.cpp','-o','build/paper-cpu-optimization/isa/isa.so']}
run.save(dest/'timing.json',result)
print(json.dumps([{'variant':variant,'mean_of_phase_medians_ms':float(np.mean([r['median_ms'] for r in rows if r['variant']==variant]))} for variant in ['generic_fallback','avx2','avx512']],indent=2))
